candidates.name: HM Land Registry plans: title plan (practice guide 40, supplement 5)
verified_facts: The guide was updated on 13 July 2026.
A title plan supports the register and provides a graphic representation of the general extent of the registered land.
Title plans use general boundaries unless a boundary has been formally determined.
Title plans may be based on different historical editions of Ordnance Survey mapping and must be read with the register.
semantic_limits: A title plan is registration context, not a bare-earth elevation raster and not automatically a surveyed exact legal-boundary coordinate source.

candidates.name: Practice guide 40: guide overview of Land Registry plans
verified_facts: Practice Guide 40 separates map basis, application-plan preparation, boundaries, determined boundaries, title plans and other plan services into distinct supplements.
The overview directs accuracy and scale questions to the specific plan supplements rather than treating every HMLR plan as equivalent.
semantic_limits: Evidence from one HMLR plan product must not be silently promoted to the legal or measurement semantics of another plan product.
